title: Synthetic data structures notes
facts: Which structure removes the most recently added item first?
A stack uses last-in, first-out order.
Which structure removes the earliest added item first?
A queue uses first-in, first-out order.
Which traversal visits tree nodes level by level?
Binary search halves a sorted search interval.
Which characters begin a JSON Markdown fence?
The literal marker ```json begins the block; ``` closes it.

title: Synthetic networking notes
facts: DNS resolves domain names to records such as IP addresses.
Which transport provides an ordered byte stream?
TCP provides a reliable, ordered byte stream.
Which HTTP method conventionally retrieves a resource?
GET requests a representation of a resource.
Which protocol adds transport encryption to HTTP?
HTTPS uses TLS to encrypt transport.
Which marker labels a JSON example in these notes?
The example uses ```json and ends with ```; both are literal text.

title: Synthetic database notes
facts: Which key uniquely identifies a table row?
A primary key uniquely identifies a row.
Which SQL clause filters rows before grouping?
WHERE filters input rows before grouping.
Which operation reverses an uncommitted transaction?
Which join preserves every row from the left table?
A left join preserves unmatched rows from the left table.
Which literal marker opens the notes' JSON sample?
The literal delimiters are ```json and ```; they are part of the example.
